notes: North (agent 1): No animal-specific poison line for Italy found with a public number: Niguarda CAV (human) does not state it covers animals; ANMVI ATV (2011) is vets-only and unverified today. Not reachable: Università di Torino Ospedale Veterinario (Grugliasco) – site returned errors/proxy 403; Ordine/rota page veterinariudine.it/reperibilita – fetch error; centroveterinarioriminese.com – robots.txt disallows (skipped); clinicavetmgioia.it (Milano) – fetch error. Gaps: no 24h clinic confirmed in Udine city, Riccione, Grado, Caorle, Cinque Terre proper, Lake Garda Veneto/Trentino shores (only Salò west shore). Bolzano district rota PDFs not opened. No province-level 'guardia medica veterinaria' found for Lombardia, Piemonte, Liguria, Emilia-Romagna, FVG. | Centre/South/islands (agent 2): No active official duty rota (Ordine/ASL) for pet owners was found in scope: Matera's weekend rota is suspended; Sassari Ordine is only planning an H24 service (Nov 2026); Reggio Calabria Ordine publishes none; Ordine Firenze-Prato site blocked by a bot-verification page. Robots/blocked: ospedaleveterinario.uniss.it (Sassari university hospital) disallows bots; clinicaveterinariafirenzesud.org and clinicaveterinariailgiglio.com (Firenze) disallow bots; medvet.unipg.it (Perugia OVUD 'Pronto soccorso veterinario H24' page) and veterinaria.unicam.it (Camerino/Matelica OVUD) returned errors; Bari/Valenzano university hospital page lists no emergency service. Not covered: Molise and Basilicata (no verifiable clinic site; Potenza 24h ambulance only in a 2019 news article); Elba (island app says no night on-call vet on the island – refers to Pisa ODV and mainland clinics; only aggregator source, so no Elba entries); Taormina, Capri, Amalfi town, Rome historic centre – no clinic site with emergency info found. Public vet hospital in Rome (Muratella) still under construction per ANMVI Oggi 24 Aug 2026; Ragusa/Vittoria public PS only planned (2022 article). Messina entry rests on a 2020 notice – re-verify.
